notes: THIRD PASS, under the false-refusal hardening. Zero seeds still: candidateMedia is empty and no user URL, photo or screenshot was supplied.

Passes 1 and 2 concluded UNRESOLVED because every direct fetch failed (three official 404s, retailer 403) and indexed evidence was never converted into acquisition. That was a transport failure being reported as an identity failure.

Every page listed here is expected to fail direct fetch. That is now the trigger for INDEXED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE rather than the end of the road: the runner reads an archived snapshot of the same URL, attributes it to the origin domain's authority tier, reads identifier aliases off it, and promotes any host it names into the allow-list as OBSERVED.

INDEXED_OUTBOUND_MEDIA additionally searches the archive for assets whose own path carries the article code, which is the strongest identity signal available and survives the storefront being delisted.
availableSizes is declared so sizeState can reconcile it against any declared scale. Empty sizeEvidence means the scale is unproven, which is the normal case and never a block.
